tokens.name: --color-surface
tokens.description: Main screen background (Material surface). Paper-like ground for the list and details.

tokens.name: --color-on-surface
tokens.description: Primary text and icons on surface.

tokens.name: --color-on-surface-variant
tokens.description: Secondary text: ticker exchange, timestamps, labels, supporting copy.

tokens.name: --color-surface-container-lowest
tokens.description: Lowest container tone, e.g. the lowest layer behind cards.

tokens.name: --color-surface-container-low
tokens.description: Low container tone, e.g. list cards.

tokens.name: --color-surface-container
tokens.description: Default container tone, e.g. the add-ticker sheet and dialogs.

tokens.name: --color-surface-container-high
tokens.description: High container tone, e.g. chips and the range selector.

tokens.name: --color-surface-container-highest
tokens.description: Highest container tone, e.g. the selected segment or pressed state base.

tokens.name: --color-outline
tokens.description: Borders and outlines of inputs and outlined components.

tokens.name: --color-outline-variant
tokens.description: Decorative dividers between list rows and sections.

tokens.name: --color-gain
tokens.description: Positive price change (up). Always paired with a + sign and an arrow, never color alone.

tokens.name: --color-loss
tokens.description: Negative price change (down). Always paired with a - sign and an arrow, never color alone.

tokens.name: --color-primary
tokens.description: Key actions and active states (add ticker FAB, selected range). Static fallback for devices without dynamic color.

tokens.name: --color-on-primary
tokens.description: Content on primary (text and icons on the FAB and filled buttons).

tokens.name: --color-primary-container
tokens.description: Selected or emphasized containers, e.g. the active filter chip.

tokens.name: --color-on-primary-container
tokens.description: Content on primary container.

tokens.name: --color-secondary
tokens.description: Less prominent actions and toggles.

tokens.name: --color-on-secondary
tokens.description: Content on secondary.

tokens.name: --color-secondary-container
tokens.description: Secondary containers, e.g. unselected chip backgrounds.

tokens.name: --color-on-secondary-container
tokens.description: Content on secondary container.

tokens.name: --color-tertiary
tokens.description: Contrasting accent for rare highlights (e.g. stale-data notice). Not used for gain or loss.

tokens.name: --color-on-tertiary
tokens.description: Content on tertiary.

tokens.name: --color-tertiary-container
tokens.description: Tertiary container, e.g. the stale-quote banner.

tokens.name: --color-on-tertiary-container
tokens.description: Content on tertiary container.

tokens.name: --color-error
tokens.description: Errors such as 'Couldn't fetch' and invalid ticker.

tokens.name: --color-on-error
tokens.description: Content on error.

tokens.name: --color-error-container
tokens.description: Error containers, e.g. the fetch-failed card.

tokens.name: --color-on-error-container
tokens.description: Content on error container.

tokens.name: --color-gain-container
tokens.description: Tonal background for positive change: change pills and the leading direction icon.

tokens.name: --color-on-gain-container
tokens.description: Content on gain container.

tokens.name: --color-loss-container
tokens.description: Tonal background for negative change: change pills and the leading direction icon.

tokens.name: --color-on-loss-container
tokens.description: Content on loss container.

tokens.name: --color-scrim
tokens.description: Material 3 scrim: used at 32% opacity behind modal sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: --spacing-xl

tokens.name: --spacing-touch
